info.name: Logcelot API - Log Collection System
info.description:
Complete API collection for Logcelot log collection system (Kappa Architecture).

**Features:**
- Async log ingestion (Kafka)
- Multiple formats: JSON, Syslog RFC5424, CLF
- Full-text search with filters
- ClickHouse storage with HA
- Prometheus metrics

**Quick Start:**
1. Start infrastructure: `make up`
2. Wait 30 seconds for services to be healthy
3. Run folder: `0 - Setup` (health check)
4. Run folder: `1 - Ingestion` (valid logs)
5. Wait 5-10 seconds for consumer processing
6. Run folder: `3 - Search` (query logs)

**Base URL:** http://localhost:8000
**Swagger:** http://localhost:8000/docs
**Grafana:** http://localhost:3000 (admin/admin)
